text:
emma: Planning a global soft-unpin of runtime-2.20 tomorrow at 03:00 UTC. Intend to keep a tiny safelist for known sticky combos (gptx-legacy, llama2q-legacy). Posting proposed patch and checklist.

raj: SDK question 9: any known connector/header reuse bug in SDK v3.8? Last time microversion bump caused a subtle reconnect failure.

deploybot: [deploybot] Preview pinlist diff: ```diff
--- pinlist/runtime.yaml (v2.19)
+++ pinlist/runtime.yaml (v2.20)
@@
-  - model: gptx-legacy
-    reason: longseq-kv-ref
+  # gptx-legacy remains pinned for legacy-dedicated accounts
+  - model: llama2q-legacy
+    reason: reserved-for-compat-validation
```

maya: Rollback criteria suggestion: p95 latency increase >12% sustained for 10m OR 5xx >2% for 5m. Auto-fallback: deploybot should route canary to runtime-2.19 if thresholds hit.

sam: Canary plan: start 0.5% for 15m, then 5% for 45m, then 20% if all green. Also include a 1-hour warmup for longseq workloads.

qa-bot: I'll run SDK v3.8 binding + tokenization smokes at 02:15 UTC and post results. Tests: tokenization parity, reconnect, fd-leaks, and 4k-token generation sanity.

emma: Rollback/runbook snippets if needed:
```bash
# abort ramp and revert pins
deploybot hold --scope global --reason "rollback: post-unpin regression"
# full rollback to previous runtime
deploybot rollback --env global --runtime 2.19 --reason "auto/manual rollback"
# quick re-pin for model
ndeploybot pin add --model gptx-legacy --note "re-pin on regression"
```

raj: For Dedicated customers, please include an opt-in for early testing and CS notification. Draft blurb: "We will lift a global runtime pin to 2.20; dedicated customers pinned on gptx-legacy or llama2q-legacy will remain on pinned versions. To opt into testing, open an internal ticket referencing rollout ID 3229998888." Thoughts?

deploybot: [deploybot] Pinlist staged. React :thumbsup: to approve or :x: to hold. Change scheduled at 03:00 UTC if >=2 approvals.

maya: Approving. :white_check_mark:

sam: Approving after QA smoke pass. :white_check_mark:

sre-oncall: I'll add dashboard panels for p50/p95, pod OOMs, and kvcache hit-rate. Standing by during the 3-hour post-lift monitoring window.

emma: Approved. If anyone sees anomalies during canary ping this thread and tag @sre-oncall. We'll revert quickly if thresholds trip.
